operations.setup: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm exec rer install
operations.verify: pnpm exec rer check --profile first-party && pnpm run verify && pnpm check:deployment-spec
operations.recovery: Follow OPERATIONS.md and docs/RETENTION.md: stop this installation, retain its exact source and private configuration, export through rer export, preserve the independent ERASURE_JOURNAL outside D1, attach the complete current journal to a fresh empty installation before rer import, then re-export and compare commercial records. Re-establish owner access and reconnect Pier before resuming. Never edit applied migration names or bytes.
